sources.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints
sources.claim_boundary: Published DESI constraints are an external reproduction/consistency benchmark. They are not priors to tune RLL toward and are not numerically comparable to internal delta-AIC unless likelihoods and datasets are matched.

sources.title: The Pantheon+ Analysis: Cosmological Constraints
sources.claim_boundary: Sample-size and redshift-range checks validate dataset identity only; they do not validate an RLL fit.

sources.title: Distance Priors from Planck Final Release
sources.acoustic_scale_contract: l_A uses the sound horizon at recombination r_s(z_star); r_d(z_drag) is not an interchangeable claim-bearing substitute.
sources.claim_boundary: Compressed priors are not the full Planck likelihood.

sources.title: How clustering dark energy affects matter perturbations
sources.claim_boundary: The table is a historical compilation. Individual measurements have heterogeneous surveys/methods and require covariance/overlap treatment before paper-grade joint inference.

sources.title: The Completed SDSS-IV extended Baryon Oscillation Spectroscopic Survey: measurement of the BAO and growth rate of structure of the luminous red galaxy sample
sources.claim_boundary: Method reference only; it does not retroactively provide covariance for the heterogeneous RLL growth compilation.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results IV: Alcock-Paczynski Measurements from the Lyman Alpha Forest and Cosmological Constraints
sources.relation_to_local_2025_Lya_BAO: The local DESI DR2 Table-IV Ly-alpha rows are BAO-only measurements from the same DR2 data family; the 2026 full-shape AP+BAO result is an updated correlated analysis, not an independent extra likelihood.
sources.claim_boundary: Use to stress-test/update interpretation and future alternative likelihood construction. Do not add its chi2 to the existing Ly-alpha BAO-only chi2 without an explicit joint covariance.

known_provenance_corrections.problem: stw1614 is a gravitational-lensing paper and is not the source of the fσ8 compilation.
